h: Rudeboy says going solo after P-Square was easy because he already handled production and songwriting
p: Paul Okoye, known as Rudeboy, has explained that leaving P-Square for a solo career came easily because he was already involved in production and songwriting during the group's years.
more: He has built a solo catalogue since the group split.
He did not say whether a reunion is planned.
